detail.longDescription:
Feedecho v1.34.0 now has basic RSS reader functionality.

You can selectively enable your added feeds to be Echoed and/or included in the Reader. You can also "Shout" individual articles from your feeds to your configured accounts.

Also:

- Full-text search with operators (is:starred, feed:name, in:title, in:body), keyboard shortcuts (j/k/o/m/s/?), mark-all-read with undo, density + auto-read-on-scroll + full-text view toggles.
- OPML import/export, keyword mutes, fetch-error badges, enclosures/images, mobile feeds drawer.

If you are interested in trying out the (soon to be paid) hosted version, PM me for a 14-day trial invite code! 

* Full-text view shows the feed-provided body; it is not readability extraction of the original page *yet*.

https://github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho/releases/tag/v1.34.0
